result.instructions: Tools for PostGrid, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our letters are still waiting to print, and when are they due to be sent?"; "Verify this US address and tell me the corrected version: 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy, Mountain View, CA 94043."; "Save Jane Doe at 10 Main Street, Springfield IL 62701 as a contact.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes PostGrid data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run postgrid_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run postgrid_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run postgrid_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. postgrid_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: postgrid_list_letters
tools.title: List letters
tools.description: List Print & Mail letters with their status, mailing class, recipient and send date. Print & Mail API: GET /print-mail/v1/letters.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

skip.description: Number of results to skip, for paging.

tools.name: postgrid_get_letter
tools.title: Get a letter
tools.description: Get one letter by id, including its status, the sender and recipient, the send date and the tracking data. Print & Mail API: GET /print-mail/v1/letters/{id}.

tools.name: postgrid_create_letter
tools.title: Send a letter
tools.description: Create and send a physical letter. LIVE keys print and mail it with postage; test keys send nothing. Give exactly one of html, template_id or pdf_url. Recipient and sender are a contact id or an inline contact. Print & Mail API: POST /print-mail/v1/letters.

anyOf.description: The PostGrid id, for example contact_123 or letter_123.

firstName.description: First name. Use with addressLine1 for a person.

companyName.description: Company name. Use instead of firstName for a business.

countryCode.description: ISO country code, for example US, CA, GB.

anyOf.description: An inline postal contact: firstName or companyName, plus addressLine1.

to.description: Recipient: a contact id or an inline contact.

from.description: Return address: a contact id or an inline contact.

anyOf.description: The PostGrid id, for example contact_123 or letter_123.

firstName.description: First name. Use with addressLine1 for a person.

companyName.description: Company name. Use instead of firstName for a business.

countryCode.description: ISO country code, for example US, CA, GB.

anyOf.description: An inline postal contact: firstName or companyName, plus addressLine1.

html.description: Letter content as HTML. Use instead of template_id or pdf_url.

pdf_url.description: A public URL of a PDF to print.

send_date.description: ISO date to send the letter later. Omit to send now.

mailing_class.description: PostGrid mailing class, for example first_class or standard_class.

tools.name: postgrid_cancel_letter
tools.title: Cancel a letter
tools.description: Cancel a letter that is not yet printing. Needs a short note for the audit trail. Print & Mail API: POST /print-mail/v1/letters/{id}/cancellation.

tools.name: postgrid_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact

tools.name: postgrid_create_contact

tools.description: Save a postal contact to the address book. PostGrid verifies the address when it saves the contact. Print & Mail API: POST /print-mail/v1/contacts.

firstName.description: First name. Use with addressLine1 for a person.

companyName.description: Company name. Use instead of firstName for a business.

countryCode.description: ISO country code, for example US, CA, GB.

tools.name: postgrid_list_templates
tools.title: List templates

skip.description: Number of results to skip, for paging.

tools.name: postgrid_get_template

tools.name: postgrid_verify_address
tools.title: Verify an address
tools.description: Verify and standardise a US or Canadian postal address. Returns the corrected address and a status. Each call uses 1 PostGrid lookup (billed). Address Verification API: POST /v1/addver/verifications.
